description:
What happens next? 🏡✨👇🏼

1️⃣ Earnest Money Deposit 💰➡️ You’ll submit this to show you’re serious! Held in escrow, it goes toward your down payment later.

2️⃣ Home Inspection 🔎🏠 Time to check for issues! Negotiate repairs, ask for credits, or adjust the price if needed.

3️⃣ Appraisal 📊🏡 The lender ensures you’re not overpaying by checking the home’s market value.

4️⃣ Financing Approval ✅🏦 Secure your mortgage by finalizing documents with your lender.

5️⃣ Title Search 📜🔍 A title company ensures there are no liens or claims before the home becomes yours.

6️⃣ Closing Disclosure 📑✍🏼 You’ll review the final loan terms a few days before closing.

7️⃣ Closing Day 🎉🔑 Time to sign papers, pay final costs, and make it official!

8️⃣ Get Your Keys! 🏡🔑 Funds transferred? Keys in hand? Welcome home!

9️⃣ Move In & Celebrate! 🚛📦🥂 Congrats—your new home is officially yours!

👉🏼 Sounds easy? It’s not! There’s a lot that can happen, which is why you need an expert like me to guide you every step of the way. Let’s make your homeownership dream a reality—DM me to get started! 🏡💫
